headline: Inventory down 9% YoY nationally; 28 of 50 metros have more price cuts than a year ago.

metric_registry.label: Median sale price
metric_registry.note: Not seasonally adjusted, so compare YoY

brief.text: As of May 2026, the national median sale price rose 2.2% year over year to $449,846, while inventory fell 9.0% to 1,460,440 listings. Median days on market increased by 2 days to 42, and the share of listings with price drops rose to 20.0% (+1.4pp), with 28 of 50 tracked metros seeing more price cuts than a year ago. The top alerts show 22 metros with monthly payments up 10% or more year over year, including Chicago, IL (+14%) and Houston, TX (+10%), and 4 metros with inventory down 20% or more, led by North Port, FL (-25%) and Jacksonville, FL (-24%). The 30-year mortgage rate stands at 7.03%, up 0.08pp over the past week and above last year's 6.3%. The national market remains balanced, with a temperature score of 59 relative to its own 3-year history.
key_points: Median sale price up 2.2% YoY; inventory down 9.0%.
22 metros show monthly payments up ≥10% YoY.
Mortgage rate at 7.03%, up from 6.3% a year ago.
